notes: MAINT-ARCH stories defined per ARCH-001 refactor phases and existing code structure.

change_log.note: Add schema/contract story for service boundaries

MAINT-ARCH-S1.title: Define Service Boundaries and Contracts
MAINT-ARCH-S1.description: Define explicit service interfaces and data contracts for the 4-layer modular monolith (domain, application, infrastructure, facade), including request/response schemas and dependency rules between services.

MAINT-ARCH-S2.title: Refactor Domain Logic into Modular Services
MAINT-ARCH-S2.description: Extract and reorganize existing domain logic (find_care, evaluate_care_quality, shared services) into clearly isolated service modules aligned to ARCH-001, removing cross-layer coupling and enforcing service ownership.

MAINT-ARCH-S3.title: Align Application Facades to New Service Contracts
MAINT-ARCH-S3.description: Update find_care_facade and evaluate_care_facade to consume the refactored services via defined interfaces, ensuring consistent orchestration patterns and removal of direct domain coupling.

MAINT-ARCH-S4.title: Rewire FastAPI Entrypoint and Dependency Injection
MAINT-ARCH-S4.description: Update main.py wiring to instantiate and inject refactored services and facades according to ARCH-001 layering, ensuring clean initialization and removal of legacy direct imports.

MAINT-ARCH-S5.title: Validate Refactor with Unit and Integration Tests
MAINT-ARCH-S5.description: Update and expand unit and integration tests to validate service isolation, facade orchestration, and end-to-end behavior parity with pre-refactor baseline.

MAINT-ARCH.mitigation: Enforce parity testing against existing QA baselines before enabling refactored paths.
